description: Source code for WebSocket server implementation handling WebSocket handshake, message reading, and message sending within the Chromium project.

classes.name: net::WebSocket
classes.description: Implements WebSocket server handshake, message processing, and connection management.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Handles WebSocket handshake request, validates headers, and sends handshake response.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and decodes incoming WebSocket frames, handles ping/pong and connection closure.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Encodes and sends WebSocket frames of specified opcode.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and logs failure.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response and closes the connection.
